facts.value: All students are required to obtain a grade of 'C' or higher in any course that satisfies the ASU General Studies MATH requirement.

All students pursuing a BA degree in The College of Liberal Arts and Sciences must demonstrate proficiency in a second language. Proficiency is demonstrated by completion of a language course at the intermediate level (202 or equivalent), or a higher-level course that has 202 (or its equivalent) as a prerequisite. It is recommended that students complete this requirement with Spanish (SPA) courses.
